agency.name: Mississippi Department of Mental Health (Bureau of Alcohol and Drug Services)

narrNote: Mississippi does not appear on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, checked 2026-10-22). No accredited NARR state affiliate for Mississippi at this time.
notes: Agency is SAMHSA's Single State Agency for Mississippi (Department of Mental Health; SUD services administered by its Bureau of Alcohol and Drug Services). The DMH Helpline 1-877-210-8513 is staffed 24/7 via the Office of Consumer Support and is published on both the agency SUD page and the DMH help page. Stand Up, Mississippi is the DMH-led statewide recovery/opioid initiative (treatment finder, naloxone training, recovery stories) — listed as the state's recovery-community gateway; Mississippi's peer-led Association of Mississippi Peer Support Specialists (AMPSS) exists, but its website (goampss.org) could not be fetch-verified during this run (research-tool rate limit), so it is noted here rather than listed. Medicaid SUD Services (inpatient detoxification and outpatient treatments) sit under the Division of Medicaid's Office of Mental Health, Special Mental Health Initiatives division; note the Division of Medicaid's main site displayed a temporary/migration page on 2026-10-22, though the program page linked here verified normally. Mental Health Mississippi is DMH's official service finder — searchable by county — and links DMH's Alcohol & Drug Services Resource Directory and certified-provider search.
